acceptance.given: A governed fixture has a required declaration or referenced section removed.

oracle.expected: Validation identifies the applicable rule and its relative location for each missing declaration or section.
forbidden: Validation reports failure without identifying the rule.
Validation reports failure without identifying the relative location.
oracle.observable: The validator result's diagnostics for the missing item contain the rule and a package-relative location.

acceptance.then: The diagnostics identify the applicable rule and relative location for each missing item.
acceptance.when: When the validator checks the governed fixture.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the validator test for a missing required declaration and a removed referenced section; fail if either diagnostic omits the applicable rule or package-relative location.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Emit a rule and package-relative location in diagnostics for missing required declarations and referenced sections.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting restores prior validator behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A fixture with a removed required declaration or referenced section produces a diagnostic identifying its rule and relative location.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Tests demonstrate that each missing required declaration or referenced section is rejected with its rule and relative location.

acceptance.given: The skill-authoring standard is authored or evaluated.

oracle.expected: The standard declares one primary responsibility, triggers, non-goals, I/O, dependencies, references, tests, evidence, and lifecycle boundaries.
forbidden: The standard omits any of the nine required declaration areas.
oracle.observable: The standard document contains declarations for all nine required areas.

acceptance.then: All nine required declaration areas are present.
acceptance.when: When reviewing the standard document against the required declaration set.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Review the standard document against the nine required areas and fail if any area is not declared.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Define the nine required skill-authoring areas in the standard.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Documentation-only; reverting removes the required-area declarations.

slice_hint.state_transition: The standard moves from unchecked required areas to declaring the complete set.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The standard document declares all nine required areas.
